text:
matt: OK bracket pool update: down to 8, semifinals tonight. sudden-death bragging rights on the line. :trophy:
zoe: i swear if my upset picks keep paying off i'll quit and start a consultancy for bracket voodoo. :money_with_wings:
carter: trade alert: offering my bench Reddit-sleeper (RB) for Zoe's flex (WR) + a meme gif. fair?
zoe: remove the meme gif from the negotiation and we have a deal. serious offers only. :raised_hand:
hibi: also who is bringing the "championship pizza" if we have an in-person watch? last year was soggy catastrophe. :pizza:
brenda: i'll bring if someone promises to not microwave it at the office. no exceptions.
matt: vote time: do we want an office watch party for the final or meet at the pub? poll bot to the rescue. :beer:
poll-bot: @channel Poll created: "Finals watch: Office vs Pub" 1) Office watch party 2) Pub (nearby). Vote with :one: or :two:. Ends in 45m.
carter: side convo: can we allow last-minute lineup swaps for Friday? my kicker is week-to-week chaos.
zoe: house rule: lineups lock 10m before tipoff. no mercy.
hibi: also can someone gif the iconic last-second block from 2016? need content for the group chat.
brenda: found it: https://giphy.com/gifs/last-second-block-2016-abc123 (very dramatic).
matt: carter, i accept your trade if you sweeten with that gif in the locker channel. deal?
carter: deal. sending DM with the confirmation screenshot.
zoe: also reminder: loser of the final buys the champion a victory hat — embroidered. no cheap caps.
hibi: embroidery budget approved. :moneybag:
brenda: logging disclaimer: if winner is remote, hat will be mailed + office sticker pack.
matt: halftime entertainment idea: 30-second challenge to name players who played for 3+ teams this season. prize: leftover pizza slice.
carter: this is thorough chaos and i love it. may the best bracketologist win. :mic_drop:
poll-bot: Update: 20m in, poll leaning to Pub 12->7. Poll ends at 1968881310.
zoe: pub then. i'll reserve a high-top and bring noise-cancelling cheers.
matt: perfect. will post final meetup details when i get the reservation. also will upload the trade screenshot so it's official. good luck y'all — no mercy. :sports_medal:
